+async def test_uploadfile_rolling_write_uses_threadpool(monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch) -> None:
+    stream: BinaryIO = SpooledTemporaryFile(max_size=4)  # type: ignore[assignment]
+    file = UploadFile(filename="file", file=stream, size=0)
+    writes_in_threadpool = 0
+
+    async def run_in_threadpool(func: Any, *args: Any) -> Any:

+        writes_in_threadpool += 1
+        return func(*args)
